source_boundary.handoff: the frozen WP-010 Asset authority seam (AssetHostRoute/AssetService: canonical AVAILABLE AssetRef, finite lease, fail-closed unavailable/revoked refs, media kinds and bounds) and the frozen WP-013A committed-Action consumer route (ChannelOutboundRoute::consume_once over the sealed OutboundConsumer under ActivationManifest authority) are the accepted base these cases drive
source_boundary.authority: Host Asset import under the sealed grant creates the durable ImportRecord; only a successful AVAILABLE import yields the canonical AssetRef (never from a Core Block draft, a capability, or caller text). A producer may then place that explicit AssetRef in a committed Block/Action; consumer authority only consults and checks that reference at effect time — it never creates, mints, upgrades, or re-labels Asset authority, and there is no reverse or cross-Extension authority
source_boundary.effect_boundary: two distinct effect boundaries. (A) STRUCTURAL/noncanonical committed Action input (malformed asset_id, media_type, or crop) is rejected at validation BEFORE any durable outbound row, envelope, or transport effect. (B) a CANONICAL Asset premise is admitted durably, then authoritative Asset preparation/refusal runs before the provider effect: an asset-authority refusal freezes ONE durable pre-provider-effect terminal Failed row with ActionResult result:null, CHANNEL_ASSET_IMPORT_FAILED, retryable:false, outcome:not_applied, delivery_outcome:not_sent — never dispatched, never a fabricated success. A durable prepared/refused row may exist; only denial before ANY durable row is wrong

classification.pass: the frozen contract the case asserts is satisfied by the real public route/surface: the sealed AssetHostRoute imports canonical media to a durable AVAILABLE canonical AssetRef and the accepted AssetService seam leases/reads/refuses it with finite unguessable leases and GC; the sealed ChannelOutboundRoute drains committed targeted Actions only under the current ActivationManifest and current grant, with bounded caller-deadline queues, status-first restart recovery, exact result envelopes, redaction, text-only non-regression, and runtime route lifecycle fail-closed. Every case's target outcome is PASS over the integrated seams
classification.product_red: the accepted base does not yet satisfy the frozen target for six multimodal seams (recorded as baseline, not as the permanent expectation): the v1 authorize_send rejects every asset part with CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED_MODALITY and the committed-Action consumer silently drops the Action, and the inbound route has no attachment import or assets_pending gating, so the AssetRef effect-time authority, ordering, media/crop checks, inbound attachment gating, and multimodal lease/restart recovery cannot be reached. Each executable drives the real public route to its frozen target and calls product_red ONLY when the observed result fails that target; when the target behavior is present the test returns PASS

baseline.recorded_at: accepted-base observation; not the frozen target

cases.name: canonical_available_assetref_with_valid_current_lease_under_route_authority_domain
cases.pass_basis: the dolly_runtime AssetHostRoute imports canonical PNG media to a durable AVAILABLE canonical AssetRef (AssetId = ast_b3_ + lowercase unpadded base32 of blake3-256 over the accepted bytes, exact wire shape, content-addressed object present, durable across a route reopen) under the sealed Host authority; the accepted AssetService public seam then leases and reads the SAME asset under the SAME security domain (the authority extension-connection identity) with a finite unguessable lease whose expiry blocks GC while live, and after release + grace the sweep tombstones it and every further lease/read fails closed
cases.assertion: import through AssetHostRoute; derive the AssetService capability from the same sealed domain/instance/module facts; require a canonical AssetRef, a valid current lease with bounded read under it, GC blocked while the lease is live, release + clock advance -> tombstone, and NotFound on re-lease/read

cases.name: pending_failed_deleted_stale_revoked_expired_foreign_and_noncanonical_refs_fail_closed
cases.pass_basis: the asset authority fails closed on every non-authoritative AssetRef: a never-imported route status answers explicit absent with no AssetRef, a failed import stays rejected with no asset (SIZE_LIMIT), noncanonical AssetId encodings are rejected at parse, a cross-domain read of identical bytes is denied NotFound, an expired lease confers no durability (grace-then-GC tombstones it), and a tombstoned (deleted/stale/revoked by GC) asset refuses new leases and reads with NotFound — all through the integrated route and AssetService public seams
cases.assertion: drive absent status, failed import, noncanonical ids, cross-domain denial, expired-lease GC, and tombstoned read/lease refusals; require the exact fail-closed outcomes with zero availability masquerade
references: crates/dolly-asset/src/service.rs::read / lease fail closed on NotFound

cases.name: committed_action_requires_current_manifest_grant_and_no_foreign_premise
cases.pass_basis: the sealed ChannelOutboundRoute drains a committed targeted Action only while the activating manifest that selected it is the CURRENT activation with the CURRENT grant/config/lifecycle: a replaced (new) manifest never re-drains the prior Action, an ingress premise or foreign-owner Action never yields an outbound send, and a revoked Host grant refuses the whole pass before any transport effect with a fail-closed refusal
cases.assertion: drive a text twin to Confirmed under the current manifest, then activate a new manifest and a fresh ingress premise and revoke the grant; require each pass to drain exactly its current manifest Action and the revoked pass to refuse fail-closed with zero effect

cases.name: supported_media_kinds_authoritative_detection_and_size_type_refusal
cases.pass_basis: the asset authority records an authoritative detected media type for the bounded supported kinds (image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp), refuses active content (SVG/HTML) declared as a passive image with MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH without relabeling, enforces decoded size limits with SIZE_LIMIT, and rejects malformed base64 with INVALID_BASE64 — before any AVAILABLE AssetRef
cases.assertion: import a PNG and a GIF with matching declarations, then drive an SVG-as-PNG spoof, an over-limit payload, and bad base64; require the exact refusal codes and zero availability

cases.name: channel_config_modality_part_text_bounds_fail_closed_before_dispatch
cases.pass_basis: the config case EXECUTES both sides on real seams: the shipped text-only default is exactly {text} and a committed send Action carrying an asset part under it is refused before dispatch (CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED_MODALITY, NotApplied, zero transport/durable effect); a valid within-limits asset is accepted by the asset authority under the configured limits while an over-limit source is refused SIZE_LIMIT. The {text,asset} configuration document is the frozen target: it must be accepted subject to the same 1..=32 part and 1..=262144 text bounds once the WP-013B profile lands (the v1 validate clamp is not frozen as the contract)
cases.assertion: execute the dual legs: (A) under the default text-only config, an asset-part send is refused before dispatch with zero effect; (B) with the {text,asset} modality configured within limits, a valid asset is accepted under the configured limits and an over-limit asset is refused SIZE_LIMIT; record the {text,asset} document acceptance as target_behavior
cases.target_behavior: when the WP-013B multimodal profile lands, a configuration with accepted_modalities {text,asset} within the same 1..=32 part and 1..=262144 text bounds validates and routes AssetRef send parts; the bounds checks are modality-independent

cases.name: outbound_queue_rate_and_caller_deadline_bounds_admit_nothing_expired
cases.pass_basis: through the runtime route the identity-bound gate+queue bounds a committed-action burst by the caller deadline: with the guest clock past the deadline every action is refused CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITED (retryable) before any transport effect or Core input mutation
cases.assertion: commit a three-send burst and run the consumer under an expired caller deadline; require zero transport calls and no Core host-ingress operations added

cases.name: crash_restart_recovery_is_status_first_and_replay_is_idempotent
cases.pass_basis: the sealed consumer reconciles across restart status-first: a dispatched row whose transport response was lost is never re-sent, a status query settles it exactly once, an unknown outcome is never promoted, and re-consuming a confirmed Action returns the stored frozen result with zero re-dispatch
cases.assertion: drive a Timeout dispatch, then a status-capable pass and a replay pass over the same route/store; require one status call, zero re-send, zero blind resubmit, and the stored result on replay

cases.name: exact_result_and_refusal_envelopes_on_the_outbound_route
cases.pass_basis: a confirmed committed send produces the exact frozen dolly.action-result/v1 envelope (action_id, status succeeded, result schema with contiguous unique per-piece external_message_id), and a bounded-queue refusal reports the exact common error code CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITED with zero transport effect
cases.assertion: consume a confirmed send and a deadline-refused send through the route; require the exact result envelope fields and the exact refusal code

cases.name: credentials_paths_and_signed_urls_never_enter_drafts_ledgers_or_asset_errors
cases.pass_basis: the channel drafts come from a fixed-field allowlist so transport credentials, cookies, local paths, and signed URLs never enter the committed draft, ledger row, or attempt history, and asset read/lease failures never disclose the content root, base64, or object locator
cases.assertion: ingress a hostile event carrying credential/path/signed-URL fields and refuse a tombstoned read; require none of the secrets in the ledger/draft and none of the path/base64 in the asset error surface
references: crates/dolly-asset/src/service.rs::read/lease error messages without path or bytes

cases.name: text_only_g4_nonregression_round_trip_replay_and_status_first
cases.pass_basis: the frozen G4 text path stays green end to end through the runtime route: an authenticated producer premise commits durably, a committed text send drains to Terminal Confirmed under the ActivationManifest, a byte-identical replay is idempotent, and a conflicting premise changes nothing
cases.assertion: run the full text producer -> durable premise -> consumer route; require committed premise, dispatched send, idempotent replay, and conflict refusal, all over the real Core transaction

cases.name: runtime_route_registration_lifecycle_and_fail_closed_absence
cases.pass_basis: runtime route registration and use fail closed across the lifecycle: a grant lacking the required host method refuses registration (CapabilityDenied), a revoked grant refuses every effect (StaleOrRevoked), a cross-module import request is refused before the façade, and registering the outbound route twice returns the same identity-bound gate (exactly one gate)
cases.assertion: register routes under a method-less grant, a revoked grant, and a cross-module request; require CapabilityDenied/StaleOrRevoked before any effect and one shared outbound gate

cases.name: stale_assetref_is_refused_by_an_asset_authority_at_channel_effect_time
cases.target_behavior: the committed send is settled as the ONE durable pre-provider-effect terminal Failed ActionResult: result:null, code CHANNEL_ASSET_IMPORT_FAILED, retryable:false, outcome:not_applied, delivery_outcome:not_sent, with no Dispatched marker, zero transport requests, and runtime transported 0 (rejected/failed accounting per contract). Green exactly when one Terminal Failed ActionResult with those fields is observed, the transport saw zero requests, and the runtime reported transported 0; any dispatch or untracked row is not green.
cases.seam: effect-time AssetPart authority over the route-owned Asset store/lease: a stale/unavailable/revoked AssetRef is prepared-fail-closed as a durable pre-provider-effect terminal Failed ActionResult before any transport effect, durable Dispatched marker, or success envelope.
cases.causal_red: on the accepted base before integration the outbound asset preparation seam was absent (asset parts were dropped at the profile boundary), so the exact pre-provider-effect terminal Failed envelope could not be produced; the integrated seam now freezes it.
cases.pass_basis: the committed send is settled as the ONE durable pre-provider-effect terminal Failed ActionResult: result:null, code CHANNEL_ASSET_IMPORT_FAILED, retryable:false, outcome:not_applied, delivery_outcome:not_sent, with no Dispatched marker, zero transport requests, and runtime transported 0 (rejected/failed accounting per contract) for an AssetRef that is not AVAILABLE under the route authority (unavailable/stale/revoked); a dispatch is never the target.
cases.assertion: commit a send Action whose AssetRef is not AVAILABLE under the route authority, drive it through the with-assets consumer route, and require exactly the durable pre-provider-effect terminal Failed envelope with no transport effect.
cases.setup: setup: ChannelConfig accepted_modalities exactly {text,asset} with the byte-identical canonical effective_config/config_revision persisted in the active ActivationManifest and the same config in ChannelOutboundRoute registration/consumer; the exact register_with_assets / open_channel_inbound_route_with_assets / ProviderAttachmentReader seams over ONE shared Asset root/service/capability under the same extension/module/connection/account authority. STALE lifecycle evidence: a real durable AVAILABLE Asset is imported through that same registered route and its canonical full AssetRef obtained; that exact route-owned reference is then made stale/unavailable through the authoritative Asset lifecycle (finite lease -> lease expiry -> retention grace -> GC tombstone) while the canonical AssetId is retained for the committed Action; the with-assets Channel route then prepares-fail-closed and freezes the exact pre-provider-effect terminal Failed/not_sent envelope with zero transport. No fabricated never-imported AssetId is used.

cases.name: mixed_text_and_asset_parts_reach_transport_in_exact_ordinal_order
cases.target_behavior: green is the exact piece sequence: exactly one transport request whose pieces are [text "first" (ordinal 0), asset (ordinal 1, canonical AssetId, authoritative media type), text "last" (ordinal 2)] with contiguous ordinals and a Confirmed terminal result; mere presence of any dispatch is not green
cases.seam: a committed org.dolly.channel.send Action whose parts mix text and a canonical AVAILABLE AssetRef must reach the transport as an ordered piece array with contiguous ordinals (0..n) preserving the committed order, each asset piece authorized under a current lease
cases.causal_red: authorize_send stops at the first asset part with CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED_MODALITY, so a mixed text+asset Action is silently dropped by CommittedSendAction::from_manifest_input; no ordered asset piece can be built or transported, while the identical text twin dispatches to Terminal Confirmed through the same route
cases.pass_basis: mixed text and asset Parts of a committed org.dolly.channel.send Action reach the transport as one ordered piece array with contiguous ordinals preserving the committed order, each asset piece authorized under a current lease
cases.assertion: commit a send Action with mixed text/asset/text Parts, drive it through the consumer route, and require the observed result to dispatch the ordered piece array with contiguous ordinals to the transport (pass when any dispatch is observed)
cases.setup: setup: ChannelConfig accepted_modalities exactly {text,asset} with the byte-identical canonical effective_config/config_revision persisted in the active ActivationManifest and the same config used in ChannelOutboundRoute registration/consumer; the exact register_with_assets / open_channel_inbound_route_with_assets / ProviderAttachmentReader seams over ONE shared Asset root/service/capability under the same extension/module/connection/account authority; every test Asset is created/imported/leased through that same registered route (route-owned Asset IDs/leases, no separate AssetService or manual foreign lease)

cases.name: view_crop_bounds_are_checked_against_display_geometry_at_effect_time
cases.target_behavior: green is the materialized crop observed in the typed transport/result: the exact rect computed from the authoritative prepared width/height/orientation (x0=250000,y0=0,x1=750000,y1=1000000 over 4x2 -> left=1, top=0, right=3, bottom=2) is carried by the transported piece and the Confirmed result; fixture declarations alone are not green
cases.seam: an asset Part's view/crop rectangle MUST be validated against the authoritative inspected display geometry of the AVAILABLE asset before dispatch: an empty, out-of-range, or non-fixed-point crop is refused (EMPTY_CROP/INVALID_CROP class) and no broader crop than delivered is honored

cases.pass_basis: a schema-valid normalized view/crop of an AVAILABLE asset is materialized at dispatch against the authoritative prepared display width/height/orientation with the frozen rounding; an empty or out-of-range crop is refused by a geometry authority
cases.assertion: assert the shared schema crop rules and the frozen floor/ceil materialization against the authoritative 4x2 geometry, then drive a schema-valid-crop send and require an authoritative asset/media outcome at dispatch (pass when observed)

cases.name: inbound_attachment_imports_through_assets_and_gates_block_submission_on_availability
cases.target_behavior: green is a real authenticated attachment outcome: the attachment is imported through the Asset Service (host.asset import), the block draft enters assets_pending and submits only after AVAILABLE, and the committed inbound result carries the exact AssetRef with exact ordinal order; a text-only single-text commit is never green
cases.seam: a Channel transport event carrying an attachment MUST import it through the Asset Service (host.asset import) and MUST NOT submit the inbound Block draft until every referenced asset is AVAILABLE or MUST represent failed attachments explicitly without a fabricated reference (assets_pending gating)
cases.causal_red: the inbound surface has no attachment ground: ChannelEventContent carries no attachment, InboundState has no assets_pending state, and the inbound route performs no Asset import, so a transport attachment can neither be imported nor AVAILABLE-gate the draft — while host.asset.import itself is proven working through the same route
cases.pass_basis: a Channel transport event carrying an attachment imports it through the Asset Service (host.asset import) and gates the inbound Block draft on every referenced asset being AVAILABLE (assets_pending) or represents failed attachments explicitly without a fabricated reference
cases.assertion: deliver a transport event through the inbound route and require an attachment-import / assets_pending gated outcome (pass when the committed draft is no longer a plain single text part)
cases.setup: setup: ChannelConfig accepted_modalities exactly {text,asset} with the byte-identical canonical effective_config/config_revision persisted in the active ActivationManifest and the same config used in ChannelOutboundRoute registration/consumer; the exact register_with_assets / open_channel_inbound_route_with_assets / ProviderAttachmentReader seams over ONE shared Asset root/service/capability under the same extension/module/connection/account authority; every test Asset is created/imported/leased through that same registered route (route-owned Asset IDs/leases, no separate AssetService or manual foreign lease)

cases.name: multimodal_send_crash_restart_recovery_under_original_import_and_lease
cases.target_behavior: green is per-phase exact: either a zero-effect pre-effect refusal (Rejected with an asset-authority code and zero transport) on dispatch, or a status-first resolution on restart in which a status query settles the durable multimodal row (status_calls >= 1, remaining == 0, zero re-dispatch); any dispatched/pending row alone is not green
cases.seam: a dispatched multimodal send MUST be recoverable across crash/restart status-first under its original ImportId and Asset lease (the lease invalidated only after blocking work is proven done), never re-minted, never blind-resent, never reported success while bytes may be unknown
cases.causal_red: no multimodal outbound row can exist: every asset-part Action is dropped at the profile seam before a durable Prepared row or Asset lease is created, so there is no ImportId/lease record for crash recovery, no status-first multimodal reconcile, and no lease-invalidation-after-blocking-work path
cases.pass_basis: a dispatched multimodal send is recoverable across crash/restart status-first under its original ImportId and Asset lease — never re-minted, never blind-resent, never reported success while the outcome may be unknown
cases.assertion: commit an AssetRef send, run a crash-window pass and a status-first restart pass, and require a durable multimodal row recoverable under the original ImportId/lease (pass when a dispatch, status query, or recovered row is observed)
cases.setup: setup: ChannelConfig accepted_modalities exactly {text,asset} with the byte-identical canonical effective_config/config_revision persisted in the active ActivationManifest and the same config used in ChannelOutboundRoute registration/consumer; the exact register_with_assets / open_channel_inbound_route_with_assets / ProviderAttachmentReader seams over ONE shared Asset root/service/capability under the same extension/module/connection/account authority; every test Asset is created/imported/leased through that same registered route (route-owned Asset IDs/leases, no separate AssetService or manual foreign lease)
